_about: Page-runs: spans of scans the edition serves as one document rather than one leaf at a time. Read by harness/apparatus.py; consumed by `harness edition runs` (the gate) and the reading view (the /edition/run/{id} route, and the redirect every ref in a span takes into it). A run is declared here and its content comes from `source`; the printed List of Illustrations is one list over six leaves, and serving it as six pages is serving the binding rather than the book.

_shape.id: the URL segment, /edition/run/{id}. Stable: it is a link target.
_shape.kind: which renderer. From a closed vocabulary (apparatus.KINDS); an unknown one is a gate failure rather than a page that silently falls back.
_shape.title: what the listing calls it.
_shape.refs: the scans, in binding order, contiguous within one part.
_shape.source: the store the renderer reads. Its own `source.refs` must equal `refs` here, and so must the set of per-entry `ref` fields inside it — three statements of one span, checked against each other by `edition runs` rather than merged.

_note: Chapter pages will be runs too, with their spans derived from edition/toc.json and the folio index rather than declared here. Nothing that consumes a run may care which of the two it got; see docs/edition.md.
